escena: SCENE (strategy session seen through glass, studio in Bogota, golden hour): the low sun comes in behind him and hangs in the hazy air of the room, and the photograph is taken from OUTSIDE a glass partition, so the city behind the camera is reflected across the glass in soft warm streaks that overlay him; he stands on the other side drawing the last step of a customer journey with a marker, caught at the instant the marker lifts off the glass. He wears a faded olive linen shirt with the sleeves rolled; no jacket, no navy or blue clothing. He looks at what he drew, never at the camera. A lime-green sticky note sits at the edge of the glass. 50mm lens at f/2, focus on his hand and the marker through the glass. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the lower aluminium frame of the glass partition, immediately in front of the lens
